title: Tower Stack
author: cobanov
description: Drop sliding slabs onto a rising tower: the overhang is sliced off, perfect drops snap into place and grow the slab back. Climb through golden hour and sunset into a starry night, past the line of your best tower.

controls.D-pad: UP drops the slab, like A; UP / DOWN choose in menus
controls.A: Drop the slab; pick a menu entry; play again
controls.B: Back in menus, resume; title from game over
